title: Enlarge into a room's reader context and minimise out of it (R8–R14)

tasks.title: The follow gate and the publish view (R13, R14)
Enlarge, streamed replacements and Back through the machine and the host (R9, R10)
Minimise to the own place or the lobby, and the mini view (R12)
Reconnect from ctx alone on a cold load (R11)

acs.text: WHEN a member presses Enter in the lobby (or Enlarge in the mini view) THE SYSTEM SHALL, in order: keep `host.reader.state.getSnapshot()` in memory as the viewer's own place only if the current page is a reader page (not `/social/…`); take the followed stream's current snapshot, validated, as the target (or, with nobody publishing, the library `/texts`); call `host.navigate(<target url with ctx=social.room.<id>>)` as a push; and once `host.reader.context.get()` equals that value, apply the target with origin `follow` (R9).
scenarios: Enlarging from the lobby onto the leader's place

acs.text: WHEN moves arrive from the stream while the viewer is in the context THE SYSTEM SHALL apply them only through `applySnapshot` (which replaces) and never push, so one enlarge is one history entry; WHEN the viewer goes Back THE SYSTEM SHALL be on the page they enlarged from, out of the context, with the session machine idle and nothing more applied (R10).
scenarios: Streamed moves replace, and Back leaves

acs.text: WHEN the viewer minimises THE SYSTEM SHALL push the stored own place without `ctx` if they enlarged from a reader page, else the room's lobby, keep the connection, and show the mini view (the room's name, Enlarge, Leave) in the persistent mount (R12).
scenarios: Minimising returns to the viewer's own place

acs.text: WHEN a reader address with `ctx=social.room.<id>` is loaded cold THE SYSTEM SHALL have the persistent mount connect to that room from the `ctx` value alone (no memory or storage) and resume following, with the session machine expanded (R11).
scenarios: A cold load of a ctx address reconnects

acs.text: WHEN a snapshot from another participant is applied THE SYSTEM SHALL keep only the slices that are moment-scoped in the viewer's own reader (`getSnapshot({scope: "moment"})`), so personal slices such as settings, and slices the viewer's reader does not have, are never applied (R13).
scenarios: Personal slices from others are never applied

acs.text: WHEN the viewer's stream is published THE SYSTEM SHALL remove any `ctx` from its url, every slice that is not moment-scoped, and search words from `nav`, add the `social.summary` slice (`{ref, title}` from the reader's first panel), and publish only while the viewer is in that room's context; a unit test with a fixture holding both a `ctx` and a personal slice proves it (R14).
scenarios: Outgoing snapshots carry nothing personal and no ctx
